text: A devout person takes their religion very seriously. Here, it means the people most serious about their Buddhist faith.
A revival is when something that faded becomes strong or popular again. Buddhism was pushed down, and then more people came back to it.
To denounce something is to say strongly and in public that it is wrong. The Buddhist group spoke out against people who make money from fang sheng.
Fang sheng is a Buddhist ritual in which a person frees a captive animal. Believers think it earns them spiritual merit, or good points for the soul.
Merit here means spiritual credit for doing a good deed. Some Buddhists believe freeing an animal adds to their merit, like earning points.
Ruffling feathers means upsetting or annoying people. It comes from birds, whose feathers stick up when they are bothered.
The Communist Party is the political party that runs China's government. It is the only party that holds real power there.
Exotic means coming from a faraway place and not usual where you live. Tropical birds are exotic in Shanghai.
Alas is an old-fashioned word that shows sadness or regret. The writer uses it to say it is sad that the birds could not stand the cold.
The tropics are the hot, wet parts of the world near the equator. Tiger parrots and zebra finches are used to that warmth.
A ritual is an action done in a special way, often for religious reasons, and done again and again.
To reckon is to believe or think something. Some believers reckon that freeing animals earns merit.
Captive means being held and not free, like an animal in a cage or a tank.
An atheist does not believe in any god. The Communist Party under Mao was strongly against religion.
The Cultural Revolution was a harsh time in China, from 1966 to 1976, when leader Mao Zedong tried to wipe out old ideas and traditions, including many religious ones.
Feudal describes the old system of the past, when lords ruled over poor farmers. Calling something feudal superstition was a way to say it was backward.
A superstition is a belief that something brings luck or harm, even though there is no good reason to think so.
Protein is a part of food, like meat, fish, and beans, that helps bodies grow and stay strong. In hard times, people felt freed fish were wasted food.
Incense is a stick or powder that gives off a sweet smell when it burns. Many people burn it at temples.
An abundance means a very large amount of something. China has plenty of markets selling live animals.
The chopping block is a place where an animal would be killed for food. Saving a fish from the chopping block means rescuing it before that happens.
A reservoir is a large lake, often made by people, that stores water for a town or city.
Anglers are people who fish with a rod and line. They are happy when fish are poured into a river.
A species is one kind of living thing, such as a cat or a piranha. Animals of the same species can have babies together.
A piranha is a small South American fish with sharp teeth that can bite in large groups.
Live-streamed means shown on the internet as it happens, so people far away can watch right now.
Wildlife means animals and plants living in nature, not pets or farm animals.
To wreak havoc means to cause a lot of damage and confusion. A new animal in the wrong place can do this to nature.
An ecosystem is all the living things in a place and how they depend on each other and the land and water around them.
To outbreed means to have more babies than another animal, so you slowly take over. The slider turtle does this to local reptiles.
Reptiles are cold-blooded animals with scales, like turtles, snakes, and lizards.
Infested means filled with too many of something unwanted. Beijing's canals are full of sliders.
Canals are long channels of water dug by people, often to move boats or water.
A criminal offence is something the law says is a crime, which can lead to a fine or punishment.
Hefty means large or heavy. A hefty fine is a lot of money to pay.
The yuan is the money used in China, like the dollar in the United States.
A tonne is a weight of 1,000 kilograms, about as heavy as a small car. Twelve and a half tonnes is a huge pile of fish.
A catfish is a fish with long whiskers near its mouth that look a bit like a cat's.
State-affiliated means closely linked with the government. This Buddhist group works with China's government.
A squawk is a loud, harsh bird cry. Here, it jokingly means angry noise from people online.
To police something here means to watch over it and make sure people follow the rules.
A good deed is a kind or helpful thing a person does for others, or for animals.
Intentions are the things you mean to do or hope will happen. Good intentions can still lead to a bad result.
